name: SilentXForwardBot
description: A Telegram Bot To Forward Videos And Documents Without Forward Tag.

BOT_SESSION.description: Optional alias for USER_SESSION_STRING. Add a Pyrogram user session string to forward from private/restricted Telegram chats.

USER_SESSION_STRING.description: Optional Pyrogram user session string for forwarding from private/restricted Telegram chats. SESSION_STRING and BOT_SESSION are also accepted as aliases.

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB connection URI used to store mappings, settings, and saved sessions.

SESSION_STRING.description: Optional alias for USER_SESSION_STRING. Add a Pyrogram user session string to forward from private/restricted Telegram chats.
